# KRONVEX

> Building cross-platform apps, market intelligence, and mission-critical AI to solve complex real-world problems. 100% static, privacy-first, local-execution platform hosted on GitHub Pages.

## Core Pages

- [Mission Control Home](https://kronvex.org/): Organization overview, Three-Pillar architecture, hardware detection, and quick links.
- [Android & Windows Apps](https://kronvex.org/apps): Direct GitHub Releases downloads (.apk, .exe, .msi, .zip) with SHA-256 verification.
- [AI Models & Local Browser Chat Studio](https://kronvex.org/models): Download GGUF/ONNX/Safetensors weights or run quantized ONNX models locally in the browser via WebGPU/WASM.
- [AI Skills Marketplace & .ZIP Bundler](https://kronvex.org/skills): Production-ready SKILL.md modules for Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI.
- [Top 21 Weekly & All-Time Leaderboard](https://kronvex.org/top-21): Live weekly GitHub breakouts, All-Time Most Starred repos, All-Time Most Downloaded GitHub Releases & Hugging Face AI models, and Top 21 Research Papers.
- [Top 21 AI & Programming Research Papers](https://kronvex.org/research): Verified landmark arXiv papers from Google/DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, NVIDIA, Microsoft, Samsung AI, MIT, Meta AI, Stanford, Apple & Alibaba Qwen, plus live Hugging Face Daily Papers with direct PDF, arXiv & 1-click BibTeX.
- [KRONVEX Arcade, AI Chess & Tech Quiz Arena](https://kronvex.org/arcade): 60fps Orbital Defender, local Alpha-Beta Neural Chess engine (3 AI tiers + 2P), and Trilingual (EN/FR/AR) Python, JS/TS & AI/LLM/RAG/DeepMind Mastery Arena.
- [Ecosystem Constellation](https://kronvex.org/constellation): Interactive orbital map of KRONVEX pillars, apps, AI models, and skills.
- [Enterprise & Custom Engineering](https://kronvex.org/enterprise): Tailored web/Windows/Android applications, private LLM & RAG systems, market intelligence pipelines, performance audits, and interactive project scope builder.
- [Custom Software & AI Services](https://kronvex.org/services): Full capabilities, 4-phase delivery methodology, engagement models (Prototype Sprint, Full Delivery, Dedicated Partner), and technical FAQs.
- [Engineering Case Studies](https://kronvex.org/work): Live verifiable KRONVEX architectures with Challenge, Solution, and Measured Outcomes.
- [Engineering Playbook & AI Glossary](https://kronvex.org/playbook): Six KRONVEX engineering laws and searchable 16-term AI-native, agentic, WebGPU & SEO/GEO technical glossary.
- [Vision & Roadmap](https://kronvex.org/vision): Organization manifesto, engineering principles, and multi-phase strategic roadmap.
- [Contact & Governance](https://kronvex.org/contact): Official organization email (`kronvex1@gmail.com`), Founder & Research email (`research@khalidnaami.com`), direct GitHub channels, zero-tracking inquiry composer, and security disclosure policy.

## GitHub Organization & Governance

- [KRONVEX GitHub Organization](https://github.com/KRONVEX): Official repositories and releases.
- [Control Plane Repository](https://github.com/KRONVEX/.github): Organization profile README, automated SVG telemetry engine, and org-wide defaults.
- [Security Policy](https://github.com/KRONVEX/.github/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Responsible vulnerability disclosure policy.
- [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/KRONVEX/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Engineering standards and contribution workflow.
